timeline.message:
Fallback detection for Huawei device if no HMS SDK

* We should still detect a real Huawei with HMS only as
device_type 13 even if there is no HMS library in the app.

Added missing HMS PushKit library detection

* Now correctly handles reporting missing HMS PushKit library if app
is running on an HMS only device.

replies.bodyText:
These will throw a ClassNotFoundException at runtime if missing, however if I try to catch it here the compiler thinks it's not possible won't compile.
The best we can do is change these to Exception, which is a bit better than Throwable
replies.author: jkasten2
